results.reason: Section 3 explains that the First Supplement's 10-Business-Day window lapsed without Harrowgate giving notice. Under §5.7(c), the Ferrovane non-renewal is therefore deemed cured for indemnity and closing-condition purposes. It concludes Harrowgate has lost both its indemnity and its walk-right protection, and cites the Second Supplement letter (§2) restating this.

Section 4.1 contrasts the SPA's Losses definition with the Escrow's out-of-pocket-only definition (excluding diminution in value, lost profits and attorneys' fees). It notes that Escrow §4.3 limits disbursement to Escrow-defined Losses and that SPA §11.11 lets the Escrow Agreement control disbursement mechanics, which narrows recovery.

Section 1 identifies that MSA §14.2 treats a >50% equity transfer as a deemed assignment requiring prior written consent, triggered by the 100% share purchase. It notes Annex 7.2(d) lists only lender items, so consent is neither a §7.2(d) condition nor covered by §4.4. It explains Tavinor's termination and List Price repricing remedies for a supplier covering at least 85% of requirements.
States the escrow amount is $4.85M (10% of price).
